Players Committee card image of [[Chewie With Bowcaster (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploys -1 to Falcon. While 'hit,' draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Permanent weapon is •Chewbacca's Bowcaster (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/chewiewithbowcaster_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022).
